## Summary

**PAVGB** (Vector average): Average 8 unsigned bytes with 8 unsigned bytes.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `8 x (a + b +1) >>1 → d` |
| Syntax | `PAVGB <vea>,b,d` |
| Short | Average 8 unsigned bytes with 8 unsigned bytes. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00001100` |

### Example

```asm
    pavgb    d0,d1,d2
```

```text
vea d0: 01 23 45 67 40 50 60 70
b d1: 00 53 65 E8 41 62 82 A3
Result:
d d2: 01 3B 55 A8 41 59 71 8A
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no PAVGB. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
